title: Dynamic Smart Mining network: auto-rotates across unsaturated belts (>=15% floor), prioritizing reserve deficits and tool match
note: Policy-driven autonomous Mining runner governed by game/mine-policy.json (Zero/Unity). Matches fitted tools (mining laser, ice harvester, gas harvester), prioritizes needs.tsv/supply_chains deficits while skipping full reserves, enforces live 15% regrowth floor in flight with instant cooldown rotation, and caps <=3 ships/belt atomically.
